details.description: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct is Alibaba's flagship code-specialized chat model in the Qwen2.5-Coder family: a 32.5-billion-parameter (31.0B non-embedding) transformer instruction-tuned for code generation, completion, reasoning, and repair. Released by Qwen on November 12, 2024 and trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data, Qwen's own blog describes it as matching GPT-4o's coding ability among open-source models. This Fireworks AI configuration serves the model with a 32,768-token context window, a fraction of its native 131,072-token maximum.
advantages: Qwen's Qwen2.5-Coder blog states the model matches GPT-4o's coding ability among open-source code models.
Reaches state-of-the-art results among open-source models on EvalPlus, LiveCodeBench, and BigCodeBench code-generation benchmarks, per Qwen's blog.
Reaches state-of-the-art results among open-source models on five code-completion benchmarks (HumanEval-Infilling, CrossCodeEval, CrossCodeLongEval, RepoEval, SAFIM), per Qwen's blog.
Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens spanning source code, text-code grounding, and synthetic data, per Qwen's model card.
Covers 40+ programming languages, evaluated with the McEval benchmark per Qwen's blog.
disadvantages: This Fireworks configuration caps the context window at 32,768 tokens, well below the model's native 131,072-token maximum stated on Qwen's model card.
use_cases: Code generation, completion, and debugging across mainstream programming languages
Multi-language automated code repair, evaluated by Qwen with the MdEval benchmark
Repository-level and long-context code completion tasks
Building code agents for real-world software engineering workflows
General reasoning and mathematics tasks alongside coding, per Qwen's model card
